guide.title: How file sharing works
guide.description: You can narrow who can see folders and files, or share them externally via a public link that needs no login. Combine the settings to fit your needs.

what.title: About security settings
what.body: For each folder or file you can set who can view it and whether downloads are allowed. You can also issue a public link to share with people who are not logged in.

visibility.title: Narrow visibility with a minimum role
visibility.body: Choose the minimum role that can view: supporters and above, members and above, or admins only. If unset, all members can view.

steps.s1: Open the folder-create dialog or the gear icon on a file.
steps.s2: Pick the audience from Minimum visible role.
steps.s3: After saving, people below the role can no longer see it.

download.title: Disable downloads
download.body: Use this for files you want people to view but not download. It suppresses the download button and URL issuance.

steps.s1: Open settings from the gear icon on a file.
steps.s2: Turn on Disable downloads and save.
steps.s3: Note that on-screen viewing cannot be blocked, so this is not full copy prevention.

link.title: Share externally with a public link
link.body: Issue a link that opens without login. Only admins and deputy admins can issue links.

steps.s1: Open the public-link screen from the link icon on a file.
steps.s2: Set an expiry (max 30 days) and, if needed, allow downloads or set a password.
steps.s3: Copy the created link and share it. You can revoke it when it is no longer needed.

guide.note: Public links are not indexed by search engines. However, anyone who knows the link can access it, so handle it with care.
